frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original three-dimensional lobe-finned fish skull with large spiracular openings. No full fish, fin or shoulder reconstruction; no flattened slab proxy.
uncertainties: Bilateral reconstruction of incomplete dorsal material is explicit symmetry inference.
Exact sutural paths simplified; preservation breaks are not all anatomical sutures.
Approximate55mm envelope is figure-scaled, not independently measured museum specimen.
Do not use comparison taxa Fig1f/h as Gogonasus. Panelg alone is its isolated palatoquadrate.
